title: Astrometric Stability Benchmark in Barnard's Star
notes: Evaluated cross-epoch difference using genuine SPHEREx Level 2 observations (2025-08-27 and 2026-08-21). Reprojected onto common tangential celestial grid with sigma-clipped background matching. Astrometric centroiding via DAOStarFinder confirms stable baseline displacement of 2.74" (< 0.5 pixels at 6.15"/px scale).
analysis_summary: Authentic astrometric comparison across 359-day baseline shows sub-pixel positional stability.
